theme: Translesion synthesis and replication-coupled DNA repair synthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the replication-fork synthesis machinery (PCNA damage recognition, primer synthesis, elongation, polymerase switching and the TLS polymerases POLH/POLK/POLI/REV1), framed here as DNA synthesis deployed for damage tolerance and repair, including break-induced replication and sister-chromatid repair.

theme: B cell development, activation and differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways define the B lineage itself, covering B cell identity, BCR signalling, proliferation and differentiation toward plasma cells, framed as lymphocyte development with a thymocyte module adding only peripheral T-lineage context.

theme: Replication-coupled DNA damage tolerance and repair synthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the general DNA-repair and repair-synthesis umbrella (including sister-chromatid-exchange break repair), framing the replication fork, translesion polymerases and gap-filling machinery as instruments of DNA repair.

theme: Amino acid metabolism, biosynthesis and catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover the glutamate/proline/citrulline (glutamine-family) branch of amino acid metabolism, framed as one sector of broad amino acid interconversion alongside sulfur, aromatic, serine/threonine and vitamin B6-dependent pathways.

theme: Isoprenoid-derived quinone, vitamin K and sterol metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are quinone metabolism (ubiquinol synthesis, vitamin K/menaquinone handling), framed as an isoprenoid side branch of the mevalonate pathway that also feeds cholesterol synthesis and CYP-mediated sterol catabolism.

theme: Catecholamine synthesis, reuptake and dopaminergic synaptic transmission
core_role: The shared pathways describe dopamine and catecholamine synthesis and transporter-mediated reuptake, framed as regulation of monoaminergic neurotransmission at the synapse.

theme: Common gamma-chain cytokine signalling in NK and T cells
core_role: The shared pathways are IL-15 and IL-21 signalling driving NK cell differentiation and proliferation, framed as the NK-cell arm of common gamma-chain/JAK-STAT cytokine signalling whose T-cell arm is IL-2 and IL-7.

theme: Cytosolic RNA sensing and type I interferon induction
core_role: The shared pathways are the IRF3- and ZBP1/RIP-driven signalling that induces type I interferon and NF-kB, framed as the effector output of RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA sensing in antiviral defence.

theme: T cell tolerance and regulatory T cell suppression
core_role: The shared pathways cover regulatory T cell differentiation and suppression of effector T cell proliferation and cytokine production, framed as mechanisms of peripheral tolerance and anergy.

theme: Dendritic cell IL-12/IFN-gamma drive of Th1 immunity
core_role: The shared pathways describe activated dendritic cell production of IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF, framed as the innate cytokine signal that polarises Th1 differentiation and enhances MHC antigen presentation.

theme: Glomerulus development and filtration barrier function
core_role: The shared pathways cover development of the glomerular mesangial, endothelial and epithelial compartments and vasculature, framed as building the filtration unit whose podocyte barrier and filtration function the additional pathways describe.

theme: Viral protein maturation and host manipulation during infection
core_role: The shared pathways describe SARS-CoV-1/2 targeting of host PDZ junction proteins and intracellular signalling, framed as viral manipulation of the host cell within a broader programme of viral protein processing and assembly.

theme: Glycosphingolipid and ganglioside metabolism and lysosomal storage
core_role: The shared pathways are lysosomal degradation of gangliosides and glycosphingolipids and its storage diseases (GM2 gangliosidoses, sialidosis), framed as the catabolic half of glycolipid turnover opposite their biosynthesis and GPI-anchor lipid processing.

theme: TGFBR3 co-receptor regulation of TGF-beta superfamily signalling
core_role: The shared pathways describe betaglycan (TGFBR3) modulation of TGF-beta and FGF2 signalling and its post-translational regulation, framed as co-receptor gating of growth-factor signalling extending to activin and its antagonism by follistatin.

theme: Axon regeneration and its inhibition after nerve injury
core_role: The shared pathways cover injury-induced axon sprouting, peripheral axon regeneration and RhoA-mediated growth inhibition, framed as the neuronal injury response balanced by p75NTR, ceramide and JNK growth-versus-death signalling.

theme: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators and eicosanoid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the biosynthesis of lipoxins, resolvins, protectins, maresins and related PUFA derivatives, framed as lipid mediators of inflammation resolution and tissue regeneration alongside eicosanoid inactivation by omega-oxidation.

theme: Osmotic stress response and renal ion transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover osmosensing, hyper- and hypotonic responses and renal sodium/chloride transport, framed as cellular volume and osmotic homeostasis achieved by regulating ion fluxes.

theme: Axon guidance, repulsion and collateral sprouting
core_role: The shared pathways describe axon chemorepulsion and collateral sprouting in dorsal root ganglion neurons, framed as Sema3A-driven guidance and branching during peripheral nerve wiring.

theme: Telomere maintenance by recombination and replication
core_role: The shared pathways cover telomere capping, D-loop and t-circle handling, break-induced replication and recombination-based maintenance, framed as telomere end protection and replication with links to recombination checkpoints in mitosis.

theme: Notch O-glycosylation in somite segmentation
core_role: The shared pathways describe somitogenesis and its LFNG-linked disease, framed as Notch-dependent segmentation patterning that depends on O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch in the ER and Golgi.

theme: Axon sprouting and regeneration in peripheral nerve
core_role: The shared pathways cover injury-induced axon sprouting and regulated peripheral axon regeneration, framed alongside collateral sprouting as the general capacity of axons for growth plasticity.

theme: Vasopressin-aquaporin control of renal water homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe vasopressin receptor signalling and aquaporin-mediated renal water reabsorption, framed as systemic water balance, with aquaporins extended to glycerol and urea transport.

theme: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversion via 2-oxoglutarate and nitrogen handling, framed as amino acid metabolism coupled to mitochondrial redox through the malate-aspartate shuttle.

theme: Replication stress response and genome stability
core_role: The shared pathways cover the intra-S checkpoint, resolution of recombination intermediates and p53-driven repair transcription, framed as checkpoint control of genome stability under replication stress such as fork reversal, R-loops and topoisomerase lesions.

theme: STING/IRF3 type I interferon induction and its restraint
core_role: The shared pathways describe IRF3-driven type I interferon induction and its cGAS-STING regulation, framed as antiviral innate sensing subject to negative feedback on interferon-beta.

theme: Embryonic heart development and cardiac morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover second heart field specification, cardiomyocyte, endocardial and septal differentiation and ventricle/aorta formation, framed as the early lineage-building steps of heart chamber morphogenesis.

theme: Axon guidance by semaphorin and ephrin repulsion
core_role: The shared pathways describe Sema3A and ephrin repulsive signalling, growth cone collapse and fasciculation, framed as neural wiring that extends into synapse pruning and neuron remodelling.

theme: Neutrophil and myeloid innate antimicrobial defence
core_role: The shared pathways cover myeloid inflammatory activation and neutrophil degranulation, framed as phagocyte antimicrobial effector function including respiratory burst and killing of bacteria and fungi.

theme: Glial activation and amyloid pathology in neurodegeneration
core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of microglial and astrocyte activation together with amyloid-beta and tau handling, framed as the neuroinflammatory glial response in Alzheimer-type amyloid pathology.

theme: Centrosome organisation and mitotic spindle assembly
core_role: The shared pathways cover mitotic centrosome maturation, AURKA activation by TPX2 and NuMA recruitment, framed as building the spindle through centrosome-based microtubule nucleation and anchoring.

theme: Rab-regulated endosomal recycling and membrane trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways describe Rab/TBC-regulated endocytic and receptor recycling and endosome organisation, framed as membrane trafficking that also involves tubulation and ARF-dependent Golgi budding.

theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling by Rho GTPases
core_role: The shared pathways cover actin nucleation control, severing, capping, crosslinking and bundling, framed as Rho-GTPase-directed cytoskeletal shaping of cell polarity and protrusions including filopodia and postsynaptic actin.

theme: Glycine metabolism and glycine conjugation detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways describe glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, framed as supplying glycine for mitochondrial conjugation and clearance of benzoate, salicylate and related xenobiotic acids.

theme: Bicarbonate transport and acid-base/organellar pH regulation
core_role: The shared pathways cover SLC4 bicarbonate transporters and their renal tubular acidosis disorders, framed as acid-base homeostasis alongside V-ATPase lumen acidification and carbonic anhydrase CO2 hydration.

theme: Bile acid synthesis and peroxisomal lipid oxidation
core_role: The shared pathways describe peroxisomal beta-oxidation (pristanoyl-CoA) and organic acid metabolism, framed as the organelle step that shortens sterol side chains in bile acid synthesis and homeostasis.

theme: Mitotic spindle assembly through cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover AURKA/PLK1 control of mitotic entry, centrosome maturation and spindle assembly, framed as early mitosis upstream of spindle elongation and cytokinetic ring formation.

theme: Antigen presentation and cytotoxic T/NK cell recognition
core_role: The shared pathways describe MHC class II and lipid antigen processing and presentation, framed as the antigen-presenting side of adaptive recognition alongside MHC I cross-presentation, NK/T cytotoxicity and viral immune evasion.

theme: Protein quality control and selective autophagy
core_role: The shared pathways cover misfolded-protein responses, Josephin-domain deubiquitinases and reticulophagy, framed as proteostasis through ubiquitin-dependent ERAD and selective autophagy of organelles.

theme: FGF receptor signalling cascades
core_role: The shared pathways describe FGFR3 and FGFR1 ligand binding and FRS/SHC adaptor cascades including activating mutants, framed as canonical FGFR-to-MAPK signalling across all four receptors.

theme: LXR nuclear receptor control of lipid and glucose metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe NR1H2/NR1H3 (LXR) target genes for lipogenesis, gluconeogenesis, lipolysis and VLDL remodelling, framed as nuclear-receptor transcriptional regulation of metabolism modulated by SUMOylation.

theme: Rho-family GTPase control of neuronal actin and growth cones
core_role: The shared pathways cover EPHB and RHOF-driven actin remodelling, filopodium control and postsynaptic actin organisation, framed as neuronal cytoskeletal shaping alongside RND GTPases and semaphorin-induced growth cone collapse.

theme: cGMP-mediated regulation of blood pressure and natriuresis
core_role: The shared pathways describe NO/natriuretic cGMP signalling, vasodilation, endothelin and renal sodium/urine control, framed as integrated cardiovascular-renal regulation of blood pressure.

theme: Membrane phospholipid translocation and intermembrane lipid transfer
core_role: The shared pathways cover flippase-mediated aminophospholipid translocation and intermembrane lipid transfer, framed as membrane lipid organisation underlying vesicular traffic and PI and glycolipid transport.

theme: Platelet activation and degranulation in hemostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe platelet activation via thrombin/PAR and ADP/P2Y receptors and granule secretion, framed as hemostasis supported by integrin adhesion and cytoskeletal remodelling.

theme: Innate sensing and chemokine defence against intracellular pathogens
core_role: The shared pathways cover cGAS-STING activation, CCL5 and STAT6-induced chemokines and dendritic cell cytokine production, framed as host defence against intracellular pathogens with GBP and inflammasome effectors.

theme: Intracellular calcium signalling and store-operated entry
core_role: The shared pathways describe cellular responses to calcium, calcium sequestration, caffeine-sensitive release and voltage-gated channel activation, framed as cytosolic calcium homeostasis through ER store release and store-operated entry.

theme: Glutamate/glutamine nitrogen metabolism and ammonia detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate interconversion and nitrogen utilisation, framed as nitrogen handling that feeds the urea cycle and ammonium homeostasis.

theme: FGFR4-betaKlotho endocrine FGF signalling
core_role: The shared pathways describe betaKlotho-dependent ligand binding and FGFR4 FRS/SHC-MAPK cascades, framed as the endocrine FGF branch within general FGFR1-4 signalling.
